vibe: Cinematic, moody, expensive feel, restrained legal aesthetic, authoritative

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy, strong negative space, editorial minimalism.
spacing_and_layout.hero: Full viewport height. Central alignment for brand title and search bar. Sparse and powerful composition.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento grids or strict geometric grids for principles and capabilities. 1px borders for technical/legal precision.

components.nav: Refined minimal top nav. Glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0F1A]/60 border-b border-white/10`. Minimal links.
components.hero_search_bar: Central product interaction. Refined minimal glassmorphism. `bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20`. Tall input field, soft gold icon or focus ring. NO glowing blobs.
components.cards: Dark near-black surfaces, 1px subtle steel-blue or gold-tinted border. No generic SaaS shadows. Use text contrast instead.
components.buttons: Restrained. Soft gold borders or text. No neon backgrounds.
components.logo: Custom SVG wordmark treatment for A.P.T.I.T.U.D.E.

motion.hover: Smooth hover/focus states, soft text color transitions to gold or steel-blue.
motion.video_bg: Subtle looping video layer in the hero section, darkened for readability.

media.hero_video: Agent to use a standard HTML5 <video> tag with autoplay, loop, muted, playsinline. If valid Pexels video URL is unknown, use the fallback image.

sections.name: Hero
sections.content: Video background with dark deep-navy overlay and soft gradient wash. Brand title 'A.P.T.I.T.U.D.E.', Tagline 'Accountability Is Real...'. Central full-width premium search bar spanning most of hero width. No other buttons.

sections.name: Principles / Pillars
sections.content: 3 bespoke pillars. High-end, not generic. Strict borders, large serif numbers (I, II, III). Soft gold accents.

sections.name: Capabilities
sections.content: Legal research and capabilities. Geometric layout, deep navy surfaces.

sections.name: Trust / Quote
sections.content: Large cinematic editorial quote using serif font. Muted ivory text.

sections.name: Footer
sections.content: Minimal, refined. Brand mark and minimal links.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Ivory on deep navy.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-search-input')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme and Jewel & Luxury archetype.
Avoid Inter for headings, use Cormorant Garamond or similar serif. Use Outfit or clean sans-serif for UI text.
Use standard HTML <video> tag for the hero background. Source it with a placeholder video URL or a Pexels stock video link, and use the fallback unsplash image as the poster.
Do not use generic SaaS gradients, shadows, or glowing blobs.
For the hero search bar, use a polished glassmorphism approach: bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-md, soft white border, gold focus ring.
Implement the SVG wordmark for A.P.T.I.T.U.D.E.
Every section below the hero must feel bespoke. Use 1px borders, subtle steel-blue accents, and rich typography.
Ensure the hero overlay has a gradient that improves contrast while letting the background show through (e.g., bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0A0F1A]/70 to-[#0A0F1A]).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Install and use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for icons if needed.
